definitions.explanation: A door that swings open on hinges, as opposed to a sliding door ({引|ひ}き{戸|ど}).

examples.japanese: {開|ひら}き{戸|ど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開|ひら}き{戸|ど}だ。
examples.english: This room has a hinged door.
In a narrow hallway, a sliding door takes up less space than a hinged one.

notes:
Mostly a word of architecture and home fittings; in conversation people just say ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧. Traditional Japanese rooms used sliding doors, so the distinction matters in house plans and renovation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片開|かたびら}き{戸|ど}: single hinged door
- {両開|りょうびら}き{戸|ど}: double doors (opening from the middle)
- {内開|うちびら}き / {外開|そとびら}き: opening inward / outward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{戸|ど}→引き戸：27509_hikido⟧: sliding door — the traditional Japanese type
- ⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧: door — usually a hinged, Western-style door
- ⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧: door — more formal or literary
